emptyTasks: Add a task and Vesta keeps it in sight; press {k} or type below.
emptyArchive: Nothing here yet. Done items appear here and are kept for {time}.
emptyTrash: Trash is empty. Deleted items stay here for {time}.
trashNote: Deleted tasks, subtasks and reminders. Each is removed for good {time} after deletion.
archiveNote: Done tasks, subtasks and reminders, newest first. Items stay until you restore or delete them, or until the automatic cleanup removes them after {time}.
noticeRestored: Data was restored from the backup of {date} at {time}.
noticeMoved: {n} files no longer used were moved to {path}. You can delete them.
noticeUnrecoverable: Your data could not be recovered. The damaged file was kept at {path}.
noticeFolder: Vesta cannot save to its data folder ({path}). Check that you have permission to write there.
noticeBackupFailed: Automatic backup failed. The last backup, from {date} {time}, is kept.
noticeDamaged: Your data may be damaged. Restart Vesta to restore the latest backup.
emptyRem: A reminder is a note that stays at the top. Add one below.
dragHint: {up} or {down} moves it; {left} or {right} changes its level
nowSubOf: {t}, now a subtask of {p}, position {n} of {m}
nowTop: {t}, now a top-level task, position {n} of {m}
rejoined: {t}, back in the stale group, position {n} of {m}
histOverrideCleared: Alert period back to the default
detailsPh: Add details: notes, links, checklists, tables, code…
fileTooBig: “{n}” is larger than 100 MB and was not added.
titleImagesOnly: Only images can be added to a title.
edFallback: The Milkdown editor could not load, so a plain markdown field is shown. See Settings → Logs.
title: Title
alertDefaultHelp: A task goes stale once it is older than this. Minimum 1 hour.
reblinkHelp: Stale tasks blink again this often while Vesta is visible. 30 minutes to 30 days.
toleranceHelp: After a reschedule, a task goes stale again once this much time passes. 1 hour to 30 days.
quickHelp: Offered when you hold Reschedule, and in Postpone For. Each 1 hour to 30 days; a change applies to later reschedules.
refTab: Tab moves between controls, so it cannot be a shortcut.
refPrintable: Add {mod} or {alt}: a single key would be typed as text.
refGlobalNeedsMod: This action works while typing, so it needs {mod} or a function key (F1–F12).
refInvalid: This is not a valid shortcut.
sc_close: Close Panel, Cancel Edit or Clear Selection
exportNote: Vesta saves vesta-export-{d}.zip (data.json, assets/ and, if ticked, logs/) to a folder you pick.
exportSkipped_one: {count} file could not be included: it is missing or damaged on this computer.
exportSkipped_other: {count} files could not be included: they are missing or damaged on this computer.
exportFailed: The export could not be saved.
importMerged: Merged: {a} added, {u} updated, {s} unchanged because the local version was the same or newer. A backup from just before the import was kept.
importNotVesta: This is not a Vesta export.
importNewer: This export was made by a newer version of Vesta. Update Vesta, then import it again.
importDamagedChecksum: This export is damaged: a file does not match its checksum ({where}).
importDamagedMissing: This export is damaged: a listed file is missing ({where}).
importDamagedSize: This export is damaged: a file's size does not match the list ({where}).
importDamagedTooLarge: This export is damaged: a file is larger than 100 MB ({where}).
importDamagedField: This export is damaged: an invalid value ({where}).
importDamagedData: This export is damaged: its data.json is too large.
importNotStarted: The import did not start: Vesta could not back up your data first.
dataRefusedNewer: Export and import are not available while this data is from a newer version of Vesta.
importFailedRestored: The import could not be completed. Your data was restored to how it was before the import.
undoImportEnded: Undo import is no longer available.
importUndone: Import undone. Your data is back to how it was before the import.
undoFailed: The import could not be undone.
logsNote: Logs never leave this computer unless you export them. At most 50 MiB, in 1 MiB files.
logsUnreadable: The logs could not be read.
updatesNoteAuto: Vesta asks GitHub Releases for the latest version at start and once a day. Nothing about you or your data is sent.
updatesNoteManual: Vesta asks GitHub Releases for the latest version only when you press Check for updates. Nothing about you or your data is sent.
updateFailed: Vesta could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
fileConfirmDetail: From {folder}. Vesta keeps its own copy; the original file is not changed.
fileInsideData: “{n}” is inside Vesta's data folder and cannot be added.
importNoSpace: There is not enough free space on this disk for this import.
importDamagedTooMany: This export is damaged: it lists more than 10,000 files.
importDamagedTooLargeTotal: This export is damaged: its files total more than 4 GiB.
noticeAbnormalExit: Vesta closed after an unexpected problem. Details are in the {logs}.
noticeNewerData: This data was saved by a newer version of Vesta. Open it with that version or a newer one.
remindCheck: Remind me to check for updates
reminderNotice: Automatic update checks are off. Check for updates in Settings.
cpAdjusted: Adjusted for contrast in this theme
fmTableHint: Hold or {shiftEnter} to choose the size
tsRange: Type a whole number from 1 to 100.
tableRowsFirst: Rows before columns in table sizes
paletteHelp: Themes change only the colors. “System” is the default when Appearance follows the system.
appearanceHelp: “System” follows the appearance set in the system settings.
thirdPartyMissing: Third-party licenses are included with release builds.
aboutTrademark: The Vesta name, logo, visual identity and vesta.tools are reserved by Leandro Gonçalves and are not covered by the license.

aboutTextMac: Vesta keeps tasks on this Mac and tells you when one has gone cold. No account, no telemetry, no cloud.
aboutTextOther: Vesta keeps tasks on this computer and tells you when one has gone cold. No account, no telemetry, no cloud.
linkUnsafe: This link's address is not safe, so it will not be opened.
dialogMoveHint: Arrow keys move this window; Shift+arrow keys resize it.
cleanupArchiveHelp: Done items older than this are removed for good, with their subtasks and any file nothing else uses. Checked once an hour.
cleanupTrashHelp: Deleted items older than this are removed for good, with their subtasks and any file nothing else uses. Checked once an hour.
cleanupLimits: Years 0 to 1000, days 0 to 364, hours 0 to 23; at least one hour in all.
confirmCleanupArchive_one: The next check will permanently remove {count} item from the Archive.
confirmCleanupArchive_other: The next check will permanently remove {count} items from the Archive.
confirmCleanupTrash_one: The next check will permanently remove {count} item from the Trash.
confirmCleanupTrash_other: The next check will permanently remove {count} items from the Trash.
confirmCleanupDetail: They are removed an hour after this change, with their subtasks and any file nothing else uses. This cannot be undone.
confirmTrashOffDetail: Deleted items will build up in the Trash, take space and stay on this computer until you delete them.
trashNoteOff: Deleted tasks, subtasks and reminders. They stay here until you delete them.
archiveNoteOff: Done tasks, subtasks and reminders, newest first. Items stay until you restore or delete them.
emptyTrashOff: Trash is empty. Deleted items stay here until you delete them.
emptyArchiveOff: Nothing here yet. Done items appear here and are kept until you restore or delete them.
